query: Which causal-inference strategies (difference-in-differences, synthetic controls, propensity-score matching, qualitative comparative analysis) are most feasible to attribute outcomes to AI in mixed-methods small-n pilots?

response.query: Which causal-inference strategies (difference-in-differences, synthetic controls, propensity-score matching, qualitative comparative analysis) are most feasible to attribute outcomes to AI in mixed-methods small-n pilots?
response.answer: Propensity-score matching and difference-in-differences are most feasible for attributing outcomes to AI in small-n pilots. Qualitative comparative analysis is less common but can be used for complex outcomes. Synthetic controls are less practical due to small sample sizes.
